compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: RED (integration exemption cited below)

E2E test `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_e2e.py` covering all 5 DD9 scenarios with mocked LLM dispatch.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD9: E2E test verifies cycle 1 happy path; cycle 2 PR-comment reconstruction; cycle 4 max_cycles arbiter trigger; STABLE_HALT arbiter; SHORT_CIRCUIT.

## TDD Exemption

Citing integration exemption (TDD rubric criterion 1, integration surface): the behavioral boundaries of each integration step are fully covered by the unit-test RED tasks (fa12 ledger init; 5a3b marker + append; 7712 routing branches; 932c arbiter dispatch). This E2E task tests COMPOSITION across all of them — five end-to-end scenarios that exercise the fully-wired runner with mocked LLM dispatch. The tests are written AFTER all GREEN tasks complete because each E2E scenario depends on multiple integration points being in place. The unit-test boundaries guarantee individual correctness; the E2E task validates composition.

## E2E scenarios (one test method each)

1. `test_e2e_cycle_1_happy_path` — empty ledger, no prior PR comments, mocked dispatch returns 0 findings; assert PASS branch, exit 0, cycle marker comment posted, ledger has 1 entry.
2. `test_e2e_cycle_2_reconstructs_from_pr_comment` — ledger file absent but PR has `DSO-Review-Cycle: cycle=1 commit_sha=<sha>` marker; assert `reconstruct_from_pr_comments` called with `(123, 'owner/repo')`; cycle_num=2; new findings dispatched; ledger now has 2 entries.
3. `test_e2e_cycle_4_triggers_arbiter_at_max_cycles` — ledger has 3 entries with same findings (no convergence); max_cycles=4; review produces same findings; assert DISPATCH_ARBITER fires; arbiter mock returns mixed rulings; `process_rulings` called; arbiter PR comment posted with `DSO-Arbiter-Ruling: cycle=4 commit_sha=<sha>` marker.
4. `test_e2e_stable_halt_triggers_arbiter_early` — ledger has 2 entries with identical critical findings (Jaccard=1.0 >= 0.85); review on cycle 3 produces same findings; assert STABLE_HALT → DISPATCH_ARBITER fires before max_cycles.
5. `test_e2e_short_circuit_on_rerun_with_same_sha` — ledger has cycle_num=2 with commit_sha=HEAD; arbiter-rulings.json sidecar exists for HEAD; assert `async_dispatch_specialists` is NOT called; exit code derived from prior BLOCK presence in sidecar.

## Constraints
- Use `tmp_path` fixture for artifacts_dir.
- Mock `async_dispatch_specialists`, `dispatch_arch_synthesis`, `dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter`, gh CLI subprocess.
- Use realistic fixture findings from `tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/` where applicable.
- Assertions are BEHAVIORAL: exit codes, mock-call arguments, ledger state, PR comment content. NO assertions on internal call order beyond what is semantically required.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 5 E2E test methods defined with the names above
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_e2e.py -q --co | grep -c 'test_e2e_'   # expect 5
- [ ] All 5 E2E tests pass (after all GREEN tasks complete)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_e2e.py -q
- [ ] Tests do NOT make real LLM calls (mock surface verified)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && grep -E 'patch.*dispatch_specialists|patch.*dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter|patch.*subprocess' tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_e2e.py | wc -l   # expect ≥ 5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_e2e.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_e2e.py

## File Impact
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_e2e.py (new, ~400 lines)
